company_name: Fraunhofer IMS - Institute for Microelectronic Circuits and Systems
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Fraunhofer IMS specializes in advanced microelectronic circuits and systems, focusing on Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) technologies which are relevant for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Fraunhofer IMS provides technology services in the semiconductor industry, particularly in the area of Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) for ultra-thin, hermetic, and biocompatible encapsulations. They offer a range of services from individual process steps to full sensor development, including design, prototyping, and qualification.
